acceptance_criteria.criterion: Every branch maps 1:1 to a numbered condition in handoff.md

No hard-coded upstream stage strings remain outside the re-engagement step
npm run build in mcp-server/ succeeds

summary: Step 1 (re-engagement): preserved hardcoded 'implementation' string (spec-authorized per §5.2 note).
Step 2 (FAIL → READY_FOR_DEVELOPER): isMostRecentPipelineFail filter on non-terminal, non-blocked qaWps.
Step 3 (PASS → next stage): partitionWpsAwaitingNextStage(wpsPassedQa, 'qa') with resolveNextAgent for dynamic routing (Security Auditor or Reviewer).
Step 4 (assigned_to check): IN_PROGRESS only when assigned_to === 'QA'.
Fixed partitionWpsAwaitingNextStage helper: 'awaiting' filter now uses !p.status==='PASS' condition to include WPs where next stage FAIL'd but hasn't passed yet.
Removed: wpsWithImpl, allQaPassed, wpsStillNeedingImpl, wpsNeedingNewQa, wpsWithQaInProgress, wpsWithQaFail, all multi-branch routing blocks.
6 tests updated to reflect spec v2.0.0 behavior.

comments.note: workflow-handoff.ts partitionWpsAwaitingNextStage: Changed 'awaiting' filter from !wp.pipelines.some(p => p.type === nextStage) to !wp.pipelines.some(p => p.type === nextStage && p.status === 'PASS'). This allows WPs where the next stage FAIL'd to re-route correctly. The fix is correct per spec intent: 'next stage not started' means 'no PASS pipeline' not 'no pipeline at all'. This also benefits getReviewerHandoff and getSecurityAuditorHandoff which share the helper.

workflow-handoff.ts getQaHandoff: The 'implementation:PASS' hardcoded string in the re-engagement check (step 1) is intentional per spec §5.2 implementation note — NOT a violation of AC3 (which prohibits hardcoding in contexts OTHER than the re-engagement step). This is documented in the spec rationale and is correct behavior.

tests/tools/workflow-handoff.test.ts: R2.4 test updated from READY_FOR_REVIEW to WAIT — code-review PASS means ball has moved past QA's concern. 3 more tests in the 'incomplete project detection > QA handoff' suite updated to reflect spec v2.0.0 (removed not-yet-reached-stage READY_FOR_DEVELOPER and auto-engagement IN_PROGRESS branches). tests/tools/workflow-rework-loop.test.ts: Added assigned_to: 'QA' to fixture so Step 4 fires correctly.

AC3 note: 'implementation' hardcode in Step 1 re-engagement is spec-authorized per §5.2 implementation note. Falls gracefully for first-active-stage compositions. Not a violation.
